Thank you for your pull request to OpenCRQ!
Please make sure your PR title follows the Conventional Commits convention:
  type(scope?)!?: description (#issue)
The description starts with a lowercase letter and has no trailing period.
The issue reference is required — the PR title becomes the squash-merge commit.
See .github/LABELS.md for the full taxonomy.
Examples:
  feat(scenarios): recompute risk scenarios on threat landscape changes (#123)
  fix(frontend): correct the risk heatmap legend on the CISO dashboard (#456)
  docs(quantification): update the threat-led quantification guide (#789)
-->
